description: Datarails FinanceOS brings structure and intelligence to your financial data. It provides a managed, organized database that keeps your numbers clean and reliable. Every change is fully traced with a built-in audit trail, so you always know who changed what and when. A robust permission mechanism ensures each user sees only the data they're authorized to access. And with built-in financial logic, the app understands your business context out of the box - no manual setup required.
